Allegheny Construction Specialties (Nashville, supplies and installs partitions and accessories, 615-671-1700): excluded, about 180 mi away with no stated Knoxville service.

Division X Specialties (Franklin TN): excluded, about 180 mi away. A search snippet says it supplied Scranton partitions for UT Thompson-Boling Arena in Knoxville; it could be worth adding if the distance limit is relaxed.

candidates.name: William S. Trimble Co., Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Its homepage lists 'Toilet Acc/Partitions' as a commercial product line and installation as a service. It is a Division 8 and 10 supplier (CSI Sections 8 and 10) with Bobrick among its supplier logos. Its projects include UT Fred Brown Dorm, the Knoxville airport and East Tennessee Children's Hospital. No page I read showed partition installation specifically.
candidates.reason: Long-running Knoxville Division 8/10 distributor that also installs and lists toilet partitions. Partition installation itself isn't proven, and it supplies partitions itself, so there's a buy-around risk.
red_flags: Mainly a door/hardware (Div 8) firm; partition installation not shown explicitly

license.name: William S. Trimble Co., Inc.
license.registry: Tennessee Board for Licensing Contractors via Verify TN (search.cloud.commerce.tn.gov); City of Knoxville Plans Review and Inspections contractor registration (no public list)
license.license_type: TN Alarm Contractor License (self-reported on company site; not a contractor license from the Board for Licensing Contractors)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. Could not check automatically: the state's Verify TN search (verify.tn.gov redirects to search.cloud.commerce.tn.gov) is a JavaScript app, and its search API is protected by reCAPTCHA (/api/recaptcha/verify in the page bundle). The Knoxville registration page (https://permits.knoxvilletn.gov/Register-To-Pull-A-Permit) says permit applicants must hold a city registration matched to their qualifications, sometimes alongside a TN state license. It offers no public lookup or list of registered contractors. Phone the city at 865-215-4311 to confirm. The company site lists Knoxville headquarters and company phone (865) 573-1911. It sells 'Toilet Acc/Partitions' and offers installation. The only licenses it shows are TN Alarm Contractor License #2063 and VA DCJS License #11-30049. It shows no Board for Licensing Contractors license number. Confirm by hand on verify.tn.gov.

candidates.name: National Partitions
candidates.partition_evidence: Listings describe it as a maker of modular and industrial partitioning (warehouse rooms, wire and cleanroom partitions), not toilet partitions.
candidates.reason: Wrong kind of partitions: it makes modular industrial and warehouse partitions, not restroom stalls. Its own site blocked automated access.
red_flags: Industrial modular/wire partition manufacturer, not restroom partitions

candidates.name: One Point Partitions
candidates.partition_evidence: Its site (Cloudflare-blocked; read via search snippets) sells partitions online with a pricing tool and points buyers to DIY tutorials or hiring a contractor. Its Tennessee addresses, Knoxville included, are described as delivery terminals. Its site has no clear statement that it installs.
candidates.reason: An online partitions seller, which makes it a direct competitor of Next Partitions, not an installer. Reject.
red_flags: Site blocks automated access; details from search snippets only
